method: Ordered keyword heuristics for provisional review queues, not an ontological assertion. Ambiguous cases may require multiple predicate dimensions and explicit works/events.
rules: Original forward/reverse, notes, sources are retained in federation-v1 original edge partitions
No kind classification authorizes traversal or transforms a mediated event into person-to-person contact
Do not infer family or influence from a shared period/genre or named work
Ambiguities require manual editorial and historical review
